# Play — Picture Frame

- SudokuPad: [Picture Frame on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Picture Frame on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Entropic lines are exported as generic orange lines, so read the rules text for their meaning. The frame is drawn as a line that
returns to its starting cell.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (givens, constraints, solution).
